title: Bounty Rift
description: A high-stakes bounty plugin where players' bounties increase every login! Features a tracking compass, rift teleport pearl, and exploit protection.
body:
# 🌌 Bounty Rift <!--[cite: 1] -->

A dynamic, high-stakes bounty system for Minecraft servers where the stakes rise every single time a player logs in! <!--[cite: 1] --> Perfect for survival, SMP, and competitive faction servers.

---

## ✨ Key Features

* **📈 Login Scaling Bounties:** Every time a player joins the server, their personal bounty automatically increases. <!--[cite: 1] --> The more active a player is, the bigger the target on their back becomes!
* **🔮 Custom Items:** Includes unique gameplay tools to elevate the hunt:
  * **Rift Pearl:** A powerful, **one-time use** item that instantly teleports the user straight to the player with the highest bounty on the server.
  * **Stalker Compass:** A tracking tool dedicated to pointing directly toward whoever holds the highest active bounty.
* **🛡️ Built-in Anti-Exploit:** Smart logic checks prevent players from exploiting the system by killing themselves to claim their own rewards. <!--[cite: 1] -->

---

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

### 🛠️ Admin Commands
Manage the bounty system manually with these administrative tools:
* `/bountyadmin set` — Set a player's exact bounty amount.
* `/bountyadmin add` — Add a specific amount to a player's current bounty.
* `/bountyadmin reset` — Completely reset a player's active bounty.
* `/bountyadmin give` — Manually grant the custom Rift Pearl or Stalker Compass to a player.

### 🔑 Permissions
* **`bountyrift.admin`** — Grants full access to all `/bountyadmin` commands. *(Default: OP)*

---

## ⚙️ Companion Synergy

* **👥 Team Lock (Made by us!):** To completely close the loophole of friends "bounty farming" each other, it is **highly recommended to use our custom Team Lock plugin** alongside Bounty Rift. <!--[cite: 1] --> Disabling friendly fire within teams prevents players from safely cycling money among teammates! <!--[cite: 1] -->

---

## 💵 Economy & Compatibility Notes

Don't worry about compatibility issues with your existing shop setups! 

* **No EconomyShopGUI Conflicts:** This plugin completely bypasses **EconomyShopGUI**. When you kill a player, their bounty is deposited straight into the killer's balance—it does *not* go into or interact with the shop. 
* **Safe Bounty Increases:** When a player's bounty increases upon logging in, it is handled internally and won't affect any shop system or listings.
* **Required Dependencies:** To make sure the economy and payouts function perfectly, just make sure you add these two plugins to your server:
  * **Vault**
  * **SealLib**

---

## 📌 Compatibility

* **Supported Versions:** Tested and fully operational on **1.21.1**. <!--[cite: 1] -->
* **Setup:** Drop the jar along with Vault and SealLib into your server's plugins folder and you are ready to roll!
